audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was scored 'Skill' and 2+ items was given to Fiora, while the page's own whys[0] says Ryze loses any level-1 trade she starts and whys[6] and spikes[3] say two-item Ryze out-damages her. The header also reads diff EVEN next to difficulty 8/10 and a red tone.
audit.why: The mirror (fiora__ryze) already flipped exactly these two rows — Level 1 to Fiora, 2+ items to Ryze — and the packet agrees. A 46.06% matchup rated 8/10 difficulty with a red tone is not EVEN either.
audit.corrected: phases[0]/win[0] to Fiora and phases[6]/win[6] to Ryze as matched pairs, ratings to 3/10 and 7/10, and the diff token corrected to HARD to match the difficulty text the page already carries.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page hangs on Riposte's cooldown — "commit on Riposte's cooldown", "fights start when Riposte ends" — and never once says what that cooldown is.
audit.why: Riposte is 24/22/20/18/16 at 750 range; Lunge is 13s at rank 1 falling to 6s at 400 range; Grand Challenge is 110/90/70 at 500. The 24-second rank-1 Riposte is the actual window in which Rune Prison holds, and it is the number the reader needs.
audit.corrected: Riposte's 24s rank-1 cooldown written into the spike and the do, Lunge's 400 range given, and Grand Challenge described by what it does rather than as a generic threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0], spikes[0] and early all say Fiora's Vitals deal "max-HP true damage", and early says Bladework "crits into the mark for max-HP true damage". wants.you[2] tells Ryze to survive on "shield runes".
audit.why: Riot's text for Duelist's Dance says only that hitting a Vital restores health and grants Move Speed; the trueDamage flag in the kit file sits on Grand Challenge, not the passive. Bladework is a separate ability — increased attack speed for two attacks, the first slowing and the second critting — it does not deal true damage. And the page's own rune section is Phase Rush with Second Wind and Bone Plating; Ryze has no shield rune or shield in kit.
audit.corrected: Vitals described by what the kit actually says (heal plus Move Speed on hit), Bladework given its real two-attack behaviour, and the rune reference replaced with the ones the page already recommends. The one thing that genuinely decides the matchup — Riposte stunning when it parries an immobilising effect — was already correct and is now paired with its cooldown.

edits.before: Fiora spends Riposte early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Riposte is down 24s at rank 1 — that gap is the only time your root holds.

edits.before: That is Fiora’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Never lead with the root — Riposte turns it into a stun.

edits.before: Fiora's Q-Lunge onto your first Vital deals max-HP true damage at a range your single Q cannot match, and you have no dash to reset the angle — you lose any trade she initiates.
edits.after: Lunge is a 400-range dash onto your Vital, and every Vital she hits heals her and speeds her up while you have no dash to reset the angle — you lose any trade she chooses to start.

edits.before: With W online you have a root threat, but Fiora holds Riposte (W) specifically for it — if she parries your root, she stuns you and gets a free Vital all-in while your core combo is locked out.
edits.after: With Rune Prison online you have a root threat, but Riposte is held for exactly that — parry an immobilise and her return stab stuns you, handing her a free Vital all-in while your combo is spent.

edits.before: Fiora Q-Lunges onto your first Vital before you have E online — you lose every short trade because your single Q poke is outpaced by max-HP true damage, and you have no dash to create distance.
edits.after: Fiora Lunges 400 onto your first Vital before your Flux chain even exists — every Vital she hits heals her and speeds her up, and with no dash of your own you never make the distance back.

edits.before: Fiora's Grand Challenge marks all four Vitals and the heal zone can win through your W root, but only if she eats the W into Riposte and turns it into a stun — use W only to self-peel, never to initiate.
edits.after: Grand Challenge marks all four Vitals and heals her and her allies if she lands them — and Riposte, 24s at rank 1, turns your root into a stun on you, so spend Rune Prison to peel, never to open.

edits.before: Fiora is one of the best level-1 duelists and you are one of the worst, so don't step to her — last-hit at Q range and accept you cannot trade until you have at least E to mark her first. She Q-Lunges onto your Vital before you even have the E-Q-W loop online, and Bladework (E) crits into the mark for max-HP true damage that your cloth-armor start cannot absorb. Your only tools are W (Rune Prison) and a single Q; the problem is Fiora holds her Riposte (W) specifically for your root — if she parries the W she gets a stun and a free all-in. At level 2 you gain W and the threat becomes real, but the threat only works if she hasn't banked Riposte already. At level 3 the full E-Q-W loop is online but she has Grand Challenge coming at 6; this window is about denying her Vital procs by standing near terrain so she can't circle freely, not about trading aggressively.
edits.after: Fiora is one of the best level-1 duelists and you are one of the worst, so do not step to her — last-hit from Overload's 1000 and accept you cannot trade until Spell Flux can mark her first. She Lunges 400 onto a Vital before your chain exists, and Bladework gives her two fast attacks, the first slowing you and the second critting. Your tools are one Overload and a root that only roots a Fluxed target — and Fiora holds Riposte for exactly that, because parrying an immobilise turns her stab into a stun. At level 2 the threat becomes real only if Riposte is already spent. By level 3 your loop is complete but Grand Challenge is coming: stand with terrain at your back so her rear Vitals cost her a walk through you.

edits.before: Survive the early Vital pressure with shield runes and farm, then force post-first-item trades where your E-Q-W combo cycles faster than she can reach all four Vital positions
edits.after: Survive the early Vital pressure on Second Wind and Bone Plating, then force post-item trades where your Flux chain cycles faster than she can reach all four Vital positions

edits.before: Lunge onto your first Vital, activate Bladework (E) for the guaranteed-crit re-proc, and chain into the next mark before you can W-root her off
edits.after: Lunge onto your first Vital, then Bladework — first attack slows, second crits — and reach the next mark before your root can land
